senses.gloss: , inf. בּוּת (sec. r. of בוא) to go in, lodge, pass the night.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 32:22">Targ. Gen. XXXII, 22</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Pesachim 107a:3">Pes. 107ᵃ</cite> <he>בת טוות</he> (Dan. l. c.) he went to bed without tasting food.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 95a:5">Snh. 95ᵃ</cite> (prov.) <he>בת דינא וכ׳</he> if punishment is procrastinated, punishment is gone.
<cite ref="Taanit 24b:6">Taan. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>ביתו כולי וכ׳</he> go ye all to bed fasting.
<cite ref="Pesachim 42a">Pes. 42ᵃ</cite> <he>מיא דביתו</he> (Chald. transl. of the ambiguous <he>מים שֶׁלָּנוּ</he>) water kept in vessels over night.
<cite ref="Berakhot 60b:13">Ber. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>בת בדברא</he> he slept in the open field.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 109a:2">Ib. 109ᵃ</cite> top <he>בעי למֵיבַת</he> he wanted to stay over night; a. e.—Part. <cite ref="B00031"><he>בָּאֵית</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 58:5">Targ. Is. LVIII, 5</cite>.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 47a:5">Snh. 47ᵃ</cite> <he>מֵבִית ליה למת</he> dare one postpone the burial of the dead?
